data.name: Logistics Simulator: America
data.detailed_description:
Logistics Simulator: America offers a realistic trucking and logistics experience. Deliver cargo across highways, cities, and backroads while managing fuel, time, and road challenges.

Grow your business by expanding your fleet, hiring drivers, and developing warehouses. Every delivery and decision shapes your logistics company in a dynamic economy.

Key Features:

  • Realistic truck driving with physics-based controls

  • Cargo delivery across diverse routes

  • Fleet, driver, and warehouse management

  • Dynamic economy and business growth

data.short_description: Drive across the United States as a professional trucker. Deliver cargo on highways and backroads, manage your fleet, develop your warehouses, and run a realistic logistics business. Plan routes, manage fuel and time, and take on the real challenges of life behind the wheel.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 or AMD Radeon RX 470 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-12400F or AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 6700 or NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
